speech.mp4 is a generated 640×360 solid-color video containing the public-domain JFK speech excerpt distributed by whisper.cpp as samples/jfk.wav. It is used only for media playback tests.

Source: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/blob/d1be6fde11ac6e0407606b4e42fe72d34add8037/samples/jfk.wav
Original WAV SHA-256: 59dfb9a4acb36fe2a2affc14bacbee2920ff435cb13cc314a08c13f66ba7860e

Generate with FFmpeg: color source + WAV, libx264/AAC, shortest duration, faststart. The scripts/smoke-media.mjs script reproduces it.
